title: HMW DNA Extraction from Frozen Nematodes
author: Manuela Kieninger
materials: Put sample on ice for 5 min.
Leave the sample on ice for 10 min.
Put tube in ThermoMixer at 56°C and 300 rpm for 5 min.
Let the DNA elute further in ThermoMixer for 30 min at 37°C and 300 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare pellet and LysisMix
steps.instruction: Use a frozen nematode pellet of 40–80 mg (flash‑frozen in liquid nitrogen; >100 mg not recommended). For each sample, mix 600 µL HMW gDNA Tissue Lysis Buffer with 20 µL Proteinase K to make LysisMix (prepare master mix at room temperature, then place on ice). Mix well by pipetting or vortexing.

steps.title: Add LysisMix and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add cold LysisMix to the pellet, keep on ice, homogenize with a pestle, then complete the lysis buffer volume.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL cold LysisMix to the 1.5 mL tube containing the frozen pellet; keep on ice.
If the pellet is not already in a Monarch pestle tube, transfer it to a 1.5 mL microtube that fits the pestle.
Homogenize with the pestle: perform ≥30 up‑down strokes, turning the pestle in one direction only; allow the pellet to thaw slightly on ice if needed.
Add the remaining 550 µL LysisMix (total ≈ 600 µL).

steps.title: Incubate lysate with shaking
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire lysate (~630 µL) to a 2 mL LoBind tube and incubate at 56 °C in a ThermoMixer: 750 rpm for the first 15 min, then 550 rpm for the remainder of the lysis (2 h, extendable to 4 h). Mix the lysate with a 1000 µL wide‑bore tip, then check that worms are fully digested; extend lysis or add more Proteinase K if visible worms remain. Lysate may be stored at 4 °C overnight after this step.

steps.title: Final 10‑minute incubation
steps.instruction: Return the tube to the ThermoMixer and incubate for an additional 10 min at 56 °C, 550 rpm.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the sample 5 min at 2500 rcf, leave ~30 µL behind, transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube, and add 30 µL HMW gDNA Tissue Lysis Buffer to restore the original volume.

steps.title: Add protein separation solution
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL cold Monarch Protein Separation Solution to the tube and invert immediately.

steps.title: Invert and centrifuge for phase separation
steps.instruction: Invert the tube on a wheel or rocker at 20 rpm for 1–3 min, then centrifuge at room temperature at 16 000 rcf for 25 min (or longer if needed) until two stable phases are visible; centrifuge longer if phases are not stable enough for pipetting.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Using very slow pipetting, transfer the entire upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA with beads and isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 3 Monarch DNA Capture Beads to the aqueous solution, then add 550 µL Isopropanol and invert immediately several times. Invert on a wheel or rocker at 7 rpm for 5–7 min to allow DNA binding.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and keep backup
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the liquid without disturbing the beads; keep the removed supernatant in a separate microtube in case DNA did not bind to the beads.

steps.title: Optional backup precipitation
steps.instruction: If the extraction fails, add 10 µL 3 M NaAc pH 5.2 and 200 µL additional Isopropanol to the retained supernatant, mix 40× by inversion, and centrifuge at 4 °C (high speed) to precipitate DNA.

steps.title: First bead wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Monarch gDNA Wash Buffer to the beads, then remove the wash buffer with a tip without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Second bead wash
steps.instruction: Add another 500 µL Monarch gDNA Wash Buffer, invert gently, then remove the wash buffer with a tip without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Transfer the glass beads to a 2 mL LoBind tube, add 200 µL Monarch gDNA Elution Buffer II (do not let beads dry), and short‑spin the tube for 1 s in a small centrifuge.

steps.title: Check for wool‑like material
steps.instruction: Inspect the wash buffer for any wool‑like structures; if present, collect them, spin, and elute in a separate tube (purity may be lower).

steps.title: Final bead wash and elution
steps.instruction: Place a bead retainer in a new 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube, pour the bead‑containing liquid into the retainer, add 50 µL Monarch gDNA Elution Buffer II on top to wash the beads, spin 30 s at 12 000 rcf, then pipette‑mix 20 times up‑and‑down with a bore tip.

steps.title: Overnight elution
steps.instruction: Mix well with a bore tip and incubate the tube at room temperature overnight to allow DNA to elute from the beads.

steps.title: Next‑day mixing and QC
steps.instruction: The following day, pipette‑mix with a bore tip at least 20 times, then assess DNA quality and quantity using NanoDrop, Qubit, and FemtoPulse.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL RNase A to the eluate and mix well by inversion, brief spin, or pipette mixing with a bore tip.
